## checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] tested the full lifecycle: add, edit, resize (below and above `min`), remove, reload
- [ ] tested in light **and** dark mode
- [ ] colors come from css variables, all visible text is lowercase
- [ ] user-typed text goes through `escapeHtml` before reaching `innerHTML`
- [ ] for engine changes: the plugin contract in `docs/PLUGIN_GUIDE.md` still holds (or the pr explains why it changes)
